card.name: Lupus terms in a drug label
card.fires_on: Responds to the spot just before or inside lupus-related terms (lupus, CLE, SLE) and in a few brand names, in prescribing-information text. It also fires on a small linking mark or word such as a comma-space, "and", "(" or "-" ahead of a disease or condition list.
